envelope.description: Terminal: a Build section and a 'use suggested' action on the Repo Configuration screen

body.title: Terminal: a Build section and a 'use suggested' action on the Repo Configuration screen
body.summary: In the terminal settings modal (src/cli/panes/RepoSettingsModal.tsx) show the Build rows as a section of their own and, for a repo with commands source 'none' and a suggestion, offer an action that writes the three suggested values with repo.settings.set, clearing the first key when the second cannot be written (the LLD's lone-command rule). Nothing else about the modal changes.
acceptanceChecks: The modal shows the Build rows as a section of their own with the suggestion as the placeholder of an unset row
The 'use suggested' action is offered only when commands source is 'none' and a suggestion exists, and never for a repo that has commands
It writes the three keys through repo.settings.set only when invoked, and writes nothing otherwise
When the second write fails the first key is cleared and the reason is shown, so no lone command is left
The existing modal tests pass with the section

tests.name: src/cli/__tests__/settings-modal.test.ts: the terminal Repo Configuration screen shows the Build rows as a section of their own with the suggestion as the placeholder of an unset row
